query:
SELECT
            m.uuid AS "uuid!: MarkUuid",
            m.label,
            m.note,
            m.created_at,
            ds.uuid AS "data_source_uuid!: DataSourceUuid",
            ds.name AS data_source_name,
            mf.rel_path,
            EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM assertions a
                JOIN assertion_groups g
                    ON g.id = a.group_id
                JOIN changesets c
                    ON c.id = g.changeset_id
                WHERE
                    a.data_source_id = mf.data_source_id
                    AND a.rel_path = mf.rel_path
                    AND c.state = 'accepted'
                    AND a.created_at >= m.created_at
            ) AS "done!: bool",
            EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM assertions a
                JOIN assertion_groups g
                    ON g.id = a.group_id
                JOIN changesets c
                    ON c.id = g.changeset_id
                WHERE
                    a.data_source_id = mf.data_source_id
                    AND a.rel_path = mf.rel_path
                    AND c.state = 'open'
                    AND a.retracted_at IS NULL
            ) AS "pending!: bool"
        FROM marks m
        JOIN mark_files mf
            ON mf.mark_id = m.id
        JOIN data_sources ds
            ON ds.id = mf.data_source_id
        ORDER BY m.created_at DESC, m.id DESC, ds.name, mf.rel_path
